scope: Small-displacement static linear-elastic code/research baseline; not a rated pressure, strength, seal, burst or manufactured-vessel qualification. Mesh sensitivity research; passing positive Jacobians does not imply the R03 production SICN gate is passed.

geometry.source: Own frozen C04 case geometry and versioned structural partition; actual mesh identity is bound by mesh_sha256.
geometry.display_only: Four elastomer O-rings and two PEEK rings; compression, seal contact and leakage are not modeled.
geometry.analysis_repair: Original CAD/material dimensions retained; independent curved mesh screening record must pass. Historical attempts remain unchanged.

titanium.source: R02 material-reference.json; NASA/TM-2016-218864 Table II; linear elastic constants only, no plastic curve imported; nu=0.28 is the retained R02 analysis assumption

steel.source: Alfa Laval EN1.4404/AISI316L physical-properties table gives E=200GPa; nu=0.30 is an explicit isotropic analysis assumption

adhesive.source: Explicit baseline modeling assumptions, not measured/qualified adhesive properties or an identification with the lamina's 3501-6 matrix

carbon.source: configs/copv_material_candidates.json -> elastic_control_candidate.overwrap; NASA-TM-109108 Table 1, upstream citation not independently retrieved

material_axes.definition: Q columns are [fiber, transverse, normal] in global xyz. m=-unit increasing-z meridian tangent; c=+e_theta; n=m cross c; fiber=cos(alpha)m+sin(alpha)c, transverse=-sin(alpha)m+cos(alpha)c.
material_axes.evaluation: Rotate full 3D strain/stress at each volume GP; retain transverse shear, curvature and twist. Nominal direction field is a research design choice, not a validated manufacturing winding path.

connections: Perfectly bonded shared structural interfaces; nominal gaps remain unloaded unless explicitly recorded as tied contacts. No friction, opening, cohesive damage or seal crush.

load.pressure_traction: -p*n_solid on the true inner wetted wall and internal port shoulders; exterior pressure zero.
load.equivalent_caps: Outward axial resultant equals pressure times the actual quadratic bore-edge area integral, distributed by actual Tri6 area and P2 basis on each annular end.

gauge: Free-vessel 3-2-1 nodal gauge at three separated lower-port end points; prove rank six for rigid-motion modes. This removes rigid translation/rotation, not a physical mounting clamp.

discretization.geometry: Isoparametric quadratic Gmsh TET10 coordinates; actual GP Jacobians and Tri6 boundary integrals.
discretization.displacement: Continuous vector quadratic Lagrange P2; independent midside unknowns.
discretization.stress_output: Original native cell/14GP fields; no cross-material averaging.
discretization.limitation: Repair research validation; same-geometry mesh/local stress sensitivity and production release remain pending.
discretization.mesh_optimizer: Versioned CAD-preserving mesh recipe and fixed-CAD internal SICN patches; actual method recorded with this mesh.

backend.linear_algebra: PETSc CUDA P2 FGMRES/Jacobi-Chebyshev with exact P1 transfer and CUDA P1 GAMG correction; explicit small CPU SVD coarsest level.

verification.orthotropic_specimen: Independent skfem versus FEniCSx 3-component axisymmetric Quad9, same geometry/BC/load/GP fields, plus CPU/GPU algebra equality
verification.three_dimensional_patch: Rotated 3D orthotropic straight-sided P2 element checked against analytical affine-strain energy and nodal equilibrium, with CalculiX where available
verification.full_model: Positive Jacobians and connected load path; force/moment balance, true residual, external work versus twice strain energy, cap resultants, all saved load/unload states
verification.mesh_convergence: Not certified by this run or integration-degree comparison; requires same-geometry mesh/local stress sensitivity.
